notes: Delete of replace-0016's original fact (derived, very_likely). Removing only the conclusion does not hold, so a premise must go; the definition of the largest prime factor cannot, so the factorization 1729 = 7 × 13 × 19 does. One world, so no worlds (mathematics); every derived query is 'does not know'. The subproperty queries are rephrased around the original value (19). Risk: a model can redo the trial division of 1729 on the spot; that is re-deriving the deleted fact. Side facts (verifier, round 2): the factorization goes with its other forms (the divisor list 1, 7, 13, 19, 91, 133, 247, 1729; 1729 = 19 × 91 = 7 × 247; the Carmichael-number example with factors 7, 13 and 19); a model answering 19 through them re-derived the deleted fact.
